title: MRI-guided microwave ablation of liver tumors: evaluation of efficacy and real time thermometry.
summary: The hospital's electronic database will be searched for all patients who have received microwave ablation with thermometry, and of all patients identified, age, sex, initial diagnosis, ablation time, ablation temperature, lesion diameter, area reaching thermal dose on MRI, ablation area on MRI on first day post-intervention, lesion recurrence at follow-up, time of progression, and death will be documented and evaluated.

interventions.name: retrospective analysis - Identified patients are classified by age, sex, first diagnosis, ablation time, ablation temperature, lesion diameter, area reaching thermal dose in MRI, ablation area in MRI on the first day post-intervention.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with a liver lesion who underwent microwave ablation with thermometry
Exclusion criteria:
no microwave ablation with thermometry performed
